From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>

Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Atlas Analytics — Demo recording & slides

Hi Sam,

Thanks again for taking the time today — I enjoyed walking through how Redwood can help Atlas Analytics reduce inference cost while keeping latency predictable for your batch scoring and interactive insights workflows. Quick recap and next steps: 

- Recording & slides: attached ("atlas-demo-recording.mp4", "atlas-demo-slides.pdf").
- Key fit: batching + KV caching should help with your nightly scoring jobs; routing + quantization profiles are a good match for the interactive report feature you demoed.
- Ask: would you be up for a short 15-minute Q&A to answer a couple of technical follow-ups (auth, SSO/KMS, and expected token budgets)? I can come prepared with a few config examples tailored to Atlas.

If it helps, here's my calendar to pick a 15-minute slot: https://calendly.com/marissa-redwood/15. If scheduling is tight, tell me a few windows that work and I'll coordinate. Also curious on timeline: is this something you'd prioritize this quarter or later?

Thanks — glad to keep the momentum going.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com
+1 (415) 555-0189

Attachments:
- atlas-demo-recording.mp4 (recording of today's demo, ~18m)
- atlas-demo-slides.pdf (10-slide summary & next-step checklist)
